implementation_strategy: Programmatic paired trial using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter. Pipeline: (1) deterministically generate 240 total synthetic tasks (40 discovery, 200 confirmatory) with the Cornetto-like generator; select 200 confirmatory tasks matching verifier-supported features. (2) For each confirmatory task run two episodes (baseline, guarded) using the hosted gpt-5-mini API (openai_responses) inside the adapter harness. Baseline: one direct_configuration_generation_v1 call. Guarded: initial generation + deterministic Batfish verifier run (Dockerized) and at most one repair call (generate_validate_repair_v1). (3) Parse outputs to canonical IR, serialize to verifier input, run deterministic simulation/oracle comparison; automated scoring computes regression_flag and blast_radius. (4) Archive all prompts, seeds, model outputs, verifier traces, parsed IRs, and analysis inputs. All components run with Docker (Batfish/verifier) and hosted model API; no human labour. Seeds, stratification, retry-policy, and exclusion rules are deterministic and logged.
task_manifest_strategy: Programmatic Cornetto-like generator produces canonical task manifest (JSON) deterministically stratified across topology scales (small, medium, large) and vendor-mix strata. An automated parser filters unsupported-feature tasks (moved to exploratory bucket). The confirmatory manifest consists of exactly the 200 indexed tasks above.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Transformations implemented as versioned modules: config→IR parser, vendor-to-IR mappers (BGP, OSPF, static, ACLs, VLANs, VRF), IR normalizer, verifier-serialization module. Verifier runs use Batfish in Docker with deterministic input serialization. All code and unit tests are versioned and run in CI before execution.
randomisation_plan: No random allocation across conditions (paired within-task). Prompt seeds and model-call randomness fixed per preregistered seeds; where provider supports deterministic-call mode, it will be used. Stratification into confirmatory set is deterministic.
caching_plan: Cache all LLM responses and verifier outputs (immutable archive) keyed by (task_id, condition, seed). Reuse cached responses during re-runs to conserve model calls when permitted. Cache stored in experiment artifact repo; verifier results cached per (IR, verifier-version).
failure_recovery_plan: Automatic single retry for transient API/verifier failures with identical settings. If retry fails, mark call as failed and follow missingness_plan: exclude pairs where both conditions failed for primary analysis; sensitivity analysis treats failed calls as regressions. All failures logged with deterministic codes and archived. No human adjudication.
result_schema: Schema paired_binary_episode_v1: per-episode record fields {study_id, task_id, condition, model_name, model_version, prompt_seed, model_output (raw), parsed_IR, parser_status, verifier_input, verifier_result, simulation_outcome, regression_flag (binary), blast_radius (numeric), repair_iterations (integer), call_latency_ms, call_status, artifact_hash}. Episode pairs aggregated for paired_binary_analysis_v1 executor.
estimated_compute_notes: Totals derived: task_count=200 confirmatory pairs; model call budget per adapter = task_count * 2 = 400 maximum_model_calls (one call per condition per task). Estimated_model_calls = 200 initial baseline+guarded initial calls + expected repairs. We conservatively expect 30% of guarded initial proposals will fail deterministic verification and require one repair call: estimated_model_calls = 200 (initial calls for both conditions counted as 200) + 60 repair calls = 260 total LLM calls. Maximum_model_calls = 200 tasks * 2 episodes = 400 (calculation: task_count*2). Verifier runs: up to 200 guarded verification runs plus oracle simulator comparisons for each proposed fix (≤400 verifier/simulator runs). All verifier/simulator executions run in Docker on CPU. Wall-clock finish target ≤7 days using batching; hosted LLM API call volume ≤400 (within capability_manifest cap 10,000).
